plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: A complete process system for how work starts, gets designed, gets verified, and lands: user-sized audits, brainstorming that ends at your route pick (direct / plan / goal handoff), implementation discipline (TDD, systematic debugging, evidence-gated readiness), one adversarial review, and landing that files the PR and tends CI to green. Backed by five read-only review agents. Core process skills derived from obra/superpowers (MIT) — no hooks, no dispatcher; skills fire on relevance.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Optional utilities for the workshop: html-report (report to a polished dark HTML page, from a doc or from session findings), arch-map (derived architecture maps), ui-demo-video (Playwright walkthroughs with verification frames), writing-skills (TDD for skill authoring, derived from obra/superpowers, MIT), and adopt-global-rules (installs the workshop's shipped global CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md and rules onto a machine, additively). Install alongside workbench when you want them; skip to keep sessions lean.
